results.description:
When a new guy rolls into town and actually chooses Ever, she decides it's time to stop holding on to something that was never hers to begin with. Jude.

Jude has always kept his focus where it belongs, on the club, his family, and the life he's built. Ever has just… always been there. Familiar. Easy. Untouchable in a way he never questioned.

Until she isn't. Until she's with someone else.

And suddenly, the one woman he never fought for is the only one he can't ignore. Ever is done waiting for something that was never going to happen. Jude isn't used to losing what he never claimed.

Ever thought she knew her place.
Jude thought he had everything under control.

They were both wrong.
